# The Fabryk

> > Gay travel and lifestyle blog by Fabio and Ryan, Berlin-based LGBTQ+ creators sharing authentic travel guides, destination insights, and queer-friendly adventures across Europe, Asia, and beyond.

The Fabryk documents the journeys of two gay travelers exploring the world with a focus on LGBTQ+ perspectives, cultural authenticity, and practical travel advice. The blog covers destinations including Italy, Japan, Georgia, Las Vegas, and their home base of Berlin, while also offering curated travel deals and resources for the queer community.
